symbols.name: sequence length
symbols.meaning: The number of entries in each of the two sequences, a positive integer.
symbols.quote: Let $a = (a_0, \dots, a_{t-1})$ and $b = (b_0,\dots,b_{t-1})$ be two sequences of complex numbers of length $t$, a positive integer.

symbols.name: first input sequence
symbols.meaning: The first sequence of t complex numbers, indexed from 0 to t-1.
symbols.quote: Let $a = (a_0, \dots, a_{t-1})$ and $b = (b_0,\dots,b_{t-1})$ be two sequences of complex numbers of length $t$, a positive integer.

symbols.name: second input sequence
symbols.meaning: The second sequence of t complex numbers, indexed from 0 to t-1.
symbols.quote: Let $a = (a_0, \dots, a_{t-1})$ and $b = (b_0,\dots,b_{t-1})$ be two sequences of complex numbers of length $t$, a positive integer.

symbols.name: index into a
symbols.meaning: The index of an entry of a, ranging over 0 to t-1.
symbols.quote: Here $i$ and $j$ index the entries of $a$ and $b$, and $k$ indexes the entries of $c$.

symbols.name: index into b
symbols.meaning: The index of an entry of b, ranging over 0 to t-1.
symbols.quote: Here $i$ and $j$ index the entries of $a$ and $b$, and $k$ indexes the entries of $c$.

symbols.name: index into c
symbols.meaning: The index of an entry of the output sequence c, ranging over 0 to t-1.
symbols.quote: Here $i$ and $j$ index the entries of $a$ and $b$, and $k$ indexes the entries of $c$.

symbols.name: cyclic convolution
symbols.meaning: The output sequence a \ast b of length t, whose k-th entry is the sum of a_i b_j over all pairs with i+j congruent to k modulo t.
symbols.quote: Their cyclic convolution $c = a \ast b$ is the sequence of length $t$ given by the rule below. Here $i$ and $j$ index the entries of $a$ and $b$, and $k$ indexes the entries of $c$.
